description: This source file contains extension methods for configuring Azure deployment balancers in the Orleans silos, as well as an interface definition for a service runtime wrapper providing deployment-related properties and methods.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfiguratorExtension
classes.description: Provides extension methods for configuring Azure deployment balancers for Orleans silos.

classes.name: IServiceRuntimeWrapper
classes.description: Defines an interface for interacting with runtime deployment details and notifications in an Orleans Azure context.

methods.name: UseDynamicAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the silo to use a dynamic Azure deployment balancer with an optional silo maturity period.

methods.name: UseStaticAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the silo to use a static Azure deployment balancer with an optional silo maturity period.

methods.name: GetConfigurationSettingValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration setting value by name.

methods.name: GetIPEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the IP endpoint for a specified endpoint name.

methods.name: SubscribeForStoppingNotification
methods.description: Subscribes to notification events for stopping signals.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStoppingNotification
methods.description: Unsubscribes from notification events for stopping signals.
